mapper.select: SELECT USER_ID, MEM_NAME, MEM_EMAIL, MEM_BIR, MEM_TEL, MEM_ADD1, MEM_ADD2, MEM_IMG FROM MEMBER

SELECT U.USER_ID , U.USER_PASSWORD , U.USER_ROLE , U.USER_WITHDRAW_DATE , U.USER_STATUS , U.USER_ENABLED , C.COM_NAME , C.COM_INFO , C.COM_NUM , C.COM_EMAIL , C.COM_URL , C.COM_CREATE_YEAR , C.COM_MEM , C.COM_LOGO , C.COM_PAYMENT , C.INDUSTRY_TYPE FROM COMPANY C JOIN USERS U ON C.USER_ID = U.USER_ID WHERE C.USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO COMPANY ( USER_ID, COM_NAME, COM_INFO, COM_NUM, COM_EMAIL, COM_URL, COM_CREATE_YEAR, COM_MEM, COM_LOGO, COM_PAYMENT, INDUSTRY_TYPE) VALUES( #{userId}, #{comName}, #{comInfo}, #{comNum}, #{comEmail}, #{comUrl}, #{comCreateYear}, #{comMem}, #{comLogo}, #{comPayment}, #{industryType} )
